description: Separate a Position property into X, Y (and Z) Position so each can be keyframed alone, or join them again (Animation > Separate Dimensions)

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

property.description: A property: a shortcut (anchor_point, position, scale, rotation, opacity, x_rotation, y_rotation, orientation, source_text, time_remap, audio_levels) or a path of match names or display names from the layer, e.g. ["ADBE Effect Parade", "Gaussian Blur", "Blurriness"]. Default position

separate.description: true separates, false joins. Default true

name: separate_dimensions
title: Separate Dimensions
